description: Image rows for forwarded attachments. The gallery owns the layout — rows of three (a lone row of exactly four splits two-and-two) at the message gallery row heights — and composes the shared MessageImageGallery surfaces, so forwarded images are the same component family as images in a message. Consumers only place the media (`MessageForwardedBundleGalleryTile`).

name: MessageForwardedBundleItems
description: The items surface. Without a `collapsed` prop the fold is component-owned: the surface measures its item-content slots and collapses itself to `foldLineLimit` lines when the text renders beyond that many lines in total (eight by default). Passing `collapsed` switches to the controlled mode (the detail view pins everything open) and skips the measurement.

props.name: foldLineLimit
props.description: How many rendered text lines the default fold allows before folding. Only used in the component-owned mode (`collapsed` omitted).
